a.lede: Zach Yadegari, the teen co-founder of popular Cal AI calorie tracking app, has launched a new personal AI agent startup that competes with Instinct, Muse, and Bee.
a.title: Cal AI’s 19-year-old founder just raised $10M for his new AI startup

b.lede: Mecka AI collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots. The startup pays people to record everyday tasks.
b.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
